scope: Bounded read-only search of installed Gowin V1.9.12.04 official documentation and already-generated textual artifacts; no GUI, tool process, build or hardware action during this search.

route_maxfan.official_meaning: Fanout-based routing optimization setting/guideline; not a retry count, not a count of unrouted nets and not a guarantee that every resulting net has fanout <=23.
route_maxfan.manual_source: SUG1220-2.1E_Gowin Software Tcl Commands User Guide.pdf
short_exact_excerpts: greater than 0 and less than or equal to 100
route_maxfan.config_exact_description: Set the guideline for routing fanout-based optimizations.

confirmed_report_constraint.name: report_route_congestion
confirmed_report_constraint.source: SUG940-2.0.5E_Gowin Design Timing Constraints User Guide.pdf
confirmed_report_constraint.meaning: SDC report constraint for ranked physical routing-congestion grids; not a list of failed networks. Default maximum 10 grids; congestion filters range 0..1. No documented method was found to load an already-failed routing .db into a standalone CLI and invoke this without rerunning PNR.

project_cli.source: SUG1220-2.1E_Gowin Software Tcl Commands User Guide.pdf

documented_gui_context.source: SUG940-2.0.5E_Gowin Design Timing Constraints User Guide.pdf
documented_gui_context.description: Timing Constraints Editor provides Report Route Congestion settings. This documents editing report constraints, not guaranteed extraction from a failed-routing database. No GUI was launched.
